criteria.reason: Clear recommendation with reasons; explicitly weighs health versus lifelong pension money.
Reasoning is systematic but break-even arithmetic is asserted ('well into your 80s'), not shown; assumptions unstated.
Lifespan uncertainty acknowledged via scenarios, but no data vintage for the 6.8% figure.
Advises professional consultation, but ends with directive 'Choose your health' without explicit handover of decision.

position: Draw the AHV pension early at 64
summary: Gives a direct, well-reasoned recommendation to draw early and names the health-vs-money tension, but omits break-even arithmetic, data vintage, and explicit return of the decision to the user.
